chunks.text: This week’s been a lot. I’ve been meaning to get back into reading — that sci‑fi one, The Three-Body Problem, keeps popping up in my head — and I also keep thinking it’d be nice to take a chill art class like Drawing Fundamentals.
Yeah, that sounds good — go ahead and reserve The Three-Body Problem for John Smith.
And sure, lock in that Drawing Fundamentals spot under Xu Jing — and I still owe her for something, so just send Xu Jing 507.0 when you get a sec.
